label_policy.evaluation: uncapped true RUL for all candidates

candidates.candidate_a_xgb_baseline: sentinel/train.py baseline recipe: 96-feature trailing window summary (window=30), XGBoost (max_depth=3, n_estimators=250, lr=0.04), uncapped RUL, engine-balanced sample weights
candidates.candidate_b_hgb_notebook: Reimplemented notebook recipe: 121 features (16 active sensors with StandardScaler, 15 5-cycle diffs, 90 rolling means and stds across windows 5, 10, 20), HGB (lr=0.05, max_leaf_nodes=31, random_state=42, early_stopping='off', best max_iter from [100, 150, 200, 250]), capped target (125)
candidates.candidate_c_xgb_notebook_features: Controlled ablation: XGBoost (depth=3, n_est=250, lr=0.04) trained on the 121-feature notebook matrix with capped target (125)
candidates.candidate_d_hgb_sentinel_features: Controlled ablation: HGB (lr=0.05, max_leaf_nodes=31) trained on the 96-feature trailing window matrix with uncapped target and engine-balanced weights

gate_criteria.val_missed_warning_rate: less than or equal to baseline
gate_criteria.val_near_large_overest_pct: less than or equal to baseline
gate_criteria.policy: Candidate qualifies ONLY if ALL gate conditions are satisfied on validation set. Gate is not relaxed.
